'''Hestobyll''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Byllura]]. It was located on a series of terraces that were crafted from a large river delta by a team of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] engineers. During the [[Republic Dark Age]], Hestobyll served as the capital of the [[Dyarchy]], a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] state headed by the twins [[Dromika]] and [[Quillan (Sith)|Quillan]], and a [[Dyarchy Fleet|fleet]] of Dyarchy [[Battleship/Legends|battleships]] was constructed inside secret [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]] beneath the city's reflecting pools.
